newsitem.title: ITALY: Maximum rate 8.59 pct at Italy lira reverse repo.
newsitem.headline: Maximum rate 8.59 pct at Italy lira reverse repo.

text.p: The maximum rate at today's 10.0 trillion lire 10-day Bank of Italy reverse repurchase tender was 8.59 percent, compared with 8.38 percent previously, the Bank said.
The average rate was 8.54 percent against 8.35 percent at the last repurchase pact for 11.0 trillion lire and six days on October 1.
The pact takes effect today and the securities are for resale on October 17. The Bank said it received 41 bids of which 26 were met in full and four in part.
